# Fixtures for `putty_ppk` (PuTTY private key)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour, reserved `.example` domains): encrypted with the published passphrase "saltmere"; throwaway keys used for nothing else. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/crypto.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tides.ppk` | puttygen: Ed25519, PPK 3 (Argon2id) | CC0-1.0 |
| `ferry-v2.ppk` | puttygen --ppk-param version=2: RSA 3072, PPK 2 | CC0-1.0 |
